assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire does not record unpaid domestic and care work for each person through dedicated questions or time-use modules. Domestic and care responsibilities appear in the instrument only as response options for why a person worked fewer hours (h16, option 5: "Cuidado de personas dependientes"), why a person did not look for work (j7, option 3: "Por responsabilidades familiares permanentes (cuidado de niños o personas dependientes)"), or why a person resigned from their last job (j24, option 2: "Cuidado de niños o de adultos enfermos o incapacitados"). Under the definition provided, listing domestic work only as a reason for inactivity or working fewer hours does not satisfy the requirement for dedicated measurement of domestic work.
